statement_scope_additions: For column-mean-centered observations, the right singular vectors of the data matrix are eigenvectors of the sample covariance matrix; scaling the squared singular values gives covariance eigenvalues.
The SVD implementation of covariance PCA operates on a column-mean-centered observation matrix; without centering, the covariance eigenvector interpretation need not hold.
